title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Term Reduction by Disability Compensation Rating
content:
The term of a repayment plan request on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is shortened by the combined rating of the debtor's running **Disability Compensation** award.

| Combined rating of the running Disability Compensation award | Months taken off the term |
|---|---|
| 60 percent or more | 6 (high-rating cut) |
| 30 to 50 percent | 3 (mid-rating cut) |
| 10 or 20 percent, or no running award | None under this table |

The combined rating is read from the debtor's running Disability Compensation award; ratings move in ten-point steps, so a rating of 50 percent takes the 3-month cut and a rating of 60 percent the 6-month cut.

**Hypothetical cases.** A veteran rated 100 percent: 6 months off. A veteran rated 30 percent: 3 months off. A veteran rated 20 percent: nothing off under this table. A debtor with no running award: nothing off.
